new_targets.intended_policy: The cross-root branch must prove membership of the private origin local root under the public giga root; the public destination local root only names the destination admission set.
new_targets.reachable_execution: The same-root honest path remains reachable. A cross-root witness distinguishes the mutant because it proves the public destination root as the giga-tree member instead of the private origin root.
new_targets.expected_outcome_before_run: R-ROLE/producer-state-membership involving public word 4; research verdict remains UNKNOWN without the adversarial proof route.

new_targets.intended_policy: The public withdrawal amount that controls the principal mint must be an input to the note commitment opened by the circuit.
new_targets.reachable_execution: The mutant commitment is computed with literal zero while the independent public amount still reaches fee checks and the principal mint; a note committed for zero can therefore authorize a nonzero public withdrawal subject to the remaining constraints.
new_targets.expected_outcome_before_run: R-ROLE/effect-authorization at public word 2, naming the principal mint amount as insufficiently commitment-authorized.

new_targets.intended_policy: Verifier word 2 is amount and word 8 is maximum fee on both sides of the boundary.
new_targets.reachable_execution: The consumer submits amount at word 2 and maxFee at word 8, while the mutant circuit decodes the positions in the opposite roles; unequal values distinguish the mismatch and generally reject honest proofs or reinterpret policy checks.

new_targets.intended_policy: The giga root must be admitted by gigaRootHistory and the destination local root by localRootHistory.
new_targets.reachable_execution: Honest distinct roots fail the crossed checks. A value admitted to the wrong state set has the bypass shape, but D1P-43 does not newly establish a committed adversarial route.
new_targets.expected_outcome_before_run: R-ROLE/state-identity at public words 3 and 4; research verdict remains UNKNOWN beyond seeded development evidence.

new_targets.intended_policy: The note-bound recipient authorizes the principal mint beneficiary; the relayer is authorized only for the fee mint.
new_targets.reachable_execution: A successful withdrawal executes both mints, but the mutant directs the principal amount to relayer as well as the fee.
new_targets.expected_outcome_before_run: R-ROLE/effect-beneficiary involving recipient word 10 and relayer word 9, naming the principal mint.

new_targets.intended_policy: Verifier word 2 is amount and word 8 is maximum fee on both sides of the boundary.
